title: FurnitureAssetMetadata
description: Metadata schema for 3D furniture models used in ArchGen Blender generation system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the furniture asset (e.g., 'sofa_001', 'bed_king_002').

name.description: Human-readable display name of the furniture item (e.g., 'Modern Minimalist Sofa').

room.description: Target room or area where this asset typically belongs.

style.description: Architectural or interior styles suitable for this furniture asset.

width.description: Bounding box width (X dimension in meters).

depth.description: Bounding box depth (Y dimension in meters).

height.description: Bounding box height (Z dimension in meters).

model_file.description: Relative file path from the blender/ root directory to the 3D model asset.

format.description: File format of the 3D model (GLB is strongly recommended for Three.js compatibility).

license.description: License under which this model is distributed (e.g., 'CC0', 'CC-BY-4.0', 'Proprietary').

source.description: Origin repository, platform, or creator website (e.g., 'Poly Haven', 'ambientCG', 'ArchGen Team').

source_url.description: Web URL or repository link to original asset source.

author.description: Author, 3D artist, or copyright holder name.

tags.description: Searchable tags and keywords for procedural asset matching and filtering.
